question: Does fixed financing-model reversal exit reduce loss or merely miss upside?
source: R47 fixed calibrated financing reversal predictions
selection: each era/level/horizon/date/method top ceil20percent by probability, ties industry code ascending; select before filtering outcomes; no threshold tuning
actions: hold otherwise; on alerts either cash or CSI_ALL from next-close to horizon end; date equal weighting of equal-weight eligible industry exposure
accounting: R10 shared horizon terminal liquidation: hold=(1+r)*(1-c), cash=1-c, market=(1-c)^3*(1+bm); no cash interest, no reentry or continuous portfolio; capital unit at next-close
missing: alert outcomes retained unknown; policy/date only valid if every eligible industry has complete return and market path; no survivor renormalization
comparison: FSE minus FS, identical eligible industry/date universe and top20% alert count
diagnostics: missed positive return, avoided negative return, wrong exits, annual results; no drawdown avoidance inferred from end return
limits: synthetic baskets, overlapping horizon research episodes, not executable or portfolio CAGR; no acceptance inferred from descriptive mean
